headline: Brazil Central Bank Faces Credibility Test Amid Inflation Pressures
summary: Brazil's central bank meets to decide the Selic interest rate amid rising inflation and fiscal distrust, with market analysts divided on whether the easing cycle will end prematurely.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions dictate domestic borrowing costs, currency valuations, and fixed-income returns, serving as a primary lever for monetary policy and economic growth in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic Rate
impacts.why: Persistent inflation and fiscal concerns pressure the central bank to maintain higher interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Heightened concerns over fiscal discipline and persistent inflation forced markets to reprice terminal interest rates, challenging previous easing expectations.
